description: Implementation of CallbackVisitor class for HTTP/2 frame processing and callback handling in quiche HTTP/2 adapter.

classes.name: CallbackVisitor
classes.description: Implements HTTP/2 callback handling for frame processing, headers, data, errors, and stream events.

methods.name: CallbackVisitor::CallbackVisitor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the CallbackVisitor with perspective, callbacks, and user data.

methods.name: CallbackVisitor::OnReadyToSend
methods.description: Handles the event when the connection is ready to send data.

methods.name: CallbackVisitor::OnFrameHeader
methods.description: Processes the header of an incoming frame.

methods.name: CallbackVisitor::OnSettingsStart
methods.description: Marks the start of settings frame processing.

methods.name: CallbackVisitor::OnBeginHeadersForStream
methods.description: Handles the start of headers for a stream.

methods.name: CallbackVisitor::OnHeaderForStream
methods.description: Processes individual headers for a stream.

methods.name: CallbackVisitor::OnEndHeadersForStream
methods.description: Marks the end of headers for a stream.

methods.name: CallbackVisitor::OnDataPaddingLength
methods.description: Processes padding length in data frames.

methods.name: CallbackVisitor::OnBeginDataForStream
methods.description: Handles the start of data for a stream.

methods.name: CallbackVisitor::OnDataForStream
methods.description: Processes data chunks for a stream.

methods.name: CallbackVisitor::OnEndStream
methods.description: Marks the end of a stream.

methods.name: CallbackVisitor::PopulateFrame
methods.description: Populates nghttp2_frame structure based on frame type and details.

methods.name: CallbackVisitor::GetStreamInfo
methods.description: Retrieves or creates stream info entries.
